봉영여중 추가지문 | 3학년 · 본문과 해석 WORKBOOK
STEP 01
1
본문과 해석
본문 + 해석 + 핵심 어휘 정리
원문 PASSAGE
1The halo effect is an interesting psychological phenomenon. 2It happens when one good quality of a person or product influences how we think about their other qualities. 3For example, imagine that you meet a student who is very good at English. 4You may think that the student is also good at math and science, even though you do not know their actual abilities. 5The halo effect can also be seen in advertising. 6When a famous celebrity promotes a product, people may believe that the product is excellent because they like the celebrity. 7The halo effect shows that our judgments are sometimes influenced by first impressions rather than facts. 8Therefore, we should try to judge people and products based on their actual qualities.
전체 해석
1후광 효과는 흥미로운 심리 현상이다. 2그것은 어떤 사람이나 제품의 한 가지 좋은 특성이 그 대상의 다른 특성들에 대해 우리가 생각하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 때 일어난다. 3예를 들어, 여러분이 영어를 아주 잘하는 한 학생을 만난다고 상상해 보라. 4여러분은 그 학생의 실제 능력을 알지 못하는데도, 그 학생이 수학과 과학도 잘한다고 생각할지도 모른다. 5후광 효과는 광고에서도 볼 수 있다. 6유명한 연예인이 어떤 제품을 홍보하면, 사람들은 그 연예인을 좋아하기 때문에 그 제품이 훌륭하다고 믿을지도 모른다. 7후광 효과는 우리의 판단이 때때로 사실보다는 첫인상에 영향을 받는다는 것을 보여 준다. 8그러므로 우리는 사람과 제품을 그들의 실제 특성에 근거하여 판단하려고 노력해야 한다.
필수 단어
1. halo effect[명]후광 효과
2. psychological[형]심리의, 심리적인
3. phenomenon[명]현상
4. quality[명]특성, 자질; 품질
5. influence[동]영향을 미치다
6. be good at[숙]~을 잘하다
7. even though[접]비록 ~이지만, ~인데도
8. actual[형]실제의
9. ability[명]능력
10. advertising[명]광고
11. celebrity[명]유명 인사, 연예인
12. promote[동]홍보하다, 광고하다
13. excellent[형]훌륭한, 뛰어난
14. judgment[명]판단
15. first impression[명]첫인상
16. rather than[숙]~보다는
17. judge[동]판단하다, 평가하다
18. based on[숙]~에 근거하여
동의어 ≈
1.halo effect = —
2.psychological = mental
3.phenomenon = occurrence
4.quality = trait, feature
5.influence = affect
반의어 ↔
1.halo effect ↔ —
2.psychological ↔ physical 신체의
3.phenomenon ↔ —
4.quality ↔ —
5.influence ↔ —
영영풀이
1.celebrity: a famous person, especially in movies, music or TV
2.advertising: the business of telling people about products to make them buy them
3.judgment: an opinion you form after thinking about something
4.quality: a feature of a person’s character or of a thing
5.actual: real, not imagined
필수 표현
1.good at: ~을 잘하다
2.even though: 비록 ~이지만, ~인데도
3.rather than: ~보다는
4.based on: ~에 근거하여
5.first impressions: 첫인상

어법 양자택일
둘 중 어법상 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
1.
The halo effect is an interesting 1psychology / psychological phenomenon.
후광 효과는 흥미로운 심리 현상이다.
2.
It happens when one good quality of a person or product 1influences / influence 2how do we think / how we think about their other qualities.
그것은 어떤 사람이나 제품의 한 가지 좋은 특성이 그 대상의 다른 특성들에 대해 우리가 생각하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 때 일어난다.
3.
For example, imagine 1what / that you meet a student 2who / which is very good at English.
예를 들어, 여러분이 영어를 아주 잘하는 한 학생을 만난다고 상상해 보라.
4.
You may 1think / thinks that the student is also good at math and science, 2despite / even though you do not know their actual abilities.
여러분은 그 학생의 실제 능력을 알지 못하는데도, 그 학생이 수학과 과학도 잘한다고 생각할지도 모른다.
5.
The halo effect can also 1see / be seen in advertising.
후광 효과는 광고에서도 볼 수 있다.
6.
When a famous celebrity 1promotes / promote a product, people may believe that the product is 2excellently / excellent because they like the celebrity.
유명한 연예인이 어떤 제품을 홍보하면, 사람들은 그 연예인을 좋아하기 때문에 그 제품이 훌륭하다고 믿을지도 모른다.
7.
The halo effect shows that our judgments 1is / are sometimes 2influenced / influencing by first impressions rather than facts.
후광 효과는 우리의 판단이 때때로 사실보다는 첫인상에 영향을 받는다는 것을 보여 준다.
8.
Therefore, we should try to 1judge / judging people and products 2basing / based on their actual qualities.
그러므로 우리는 사람과 제품을 그들의 실제 특성에 근거하여 판단하려고 노력해야 한다.

한글 해석 연습
주어진 영문을 한글로 해석하시오.
1.
The halo effect is an interesting psychological phenomenon.
2.
It happens when one good quality of a person or product influences how we think about their other qualities.
3.
For example, imagine that you meet a student who is very good at English.
4.
You may think that the student is also good at math and science, even though you do not know their actual abilities.
5.
The halo effect can also be seen in advertising.
6.
When a famous celebrity promotes a product, people may believe that the product is excellent because they like the celebrity.
7.
The halo effect shows that our judgments are sometimes influenced by first impressions rather than facts.
8.
Therefore, we should try to judge people and products based on their actual qualities.

STEP 6 영문 배열 8문항
1
The halo effect is an interesting psychological phenomenon.
2
It happens when one good quality of a person or product influences how we think about their other qualities.
3
For example, imagine that you meet a student who is very good at English.
4
You may think that the student is also good at math and science, even though you do not know their actual abilities.
5
The halo effect can also be seen in advertising.
6
When a famous celebrity promotes a product, people may believe that the product is excellent because they like the celebrity.
7
The halo effect shows that our judgments are sometimes influenced by first impressions rather than facts.
8
Therefore, we should try to judge people and products based on their actual qualities.
